product_one_liner.value: Luminance provides AI-powered contract drafting, negotiation, analysis and workflow automation for enterprise legal teams and other business departments.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes contract drafting, negotiation, analysis and collaboration/workflows for legal and other enterprise departments: https://www.luminance.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation directs visitors to a demo rather than pricing (https://www.luminance.com/). A pricing review checked August 31, 2026 explicitly reports no public pricing page or plans: https://legalizeai.com/blog/luminance-pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Staples appears in a customer case study (https://www.luminance.com/customers/luminance-adds-value-speeds-up-processes-and-eliminates-risk), and Imerys appears on the customer stories page (https://www.luminance.com/customers). | named_customers.0: Staples is the subject of the customer story at https://www.luminance.com/customers/luminance-adds-value-speeds-up-processes-and-eliminates-risk. | named_customers.1: Imerys is named on the customer stories page at https://www.luminance.com/customers.

employee_band.notes: Luminance's LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/luminancetech.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: London is supported by the company description updated October 1, 2026 (https://www.gartner.com/reviews/product/luminance-767552975) and its funding profile. founded_year.notes: Luminance explicitly states that it was founded in 2015: http://luminance.com/about.

eng_blog.notes: The readable resource index lists product and marketing-oriented blog posts, including proof-of-value and AI-adoption topics, without establishing two engineer-authored posts about building the product. False is based on those listings rather than an exhaustive historical archive: https://www.luminance.com/resources.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation lists numerous endpoints (https://api.luminance.com/swagger-docsv150), and the public help center lists three collections containing four articles in total (https://help.luminance.com/en).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Machine Learning Research Engineer posting is displayed with a recent repost indicator and an applicant prompt. Confidence is medium because this is a third-party job listing: https://builtin.com/job/machine-learning-research-engineer/6882726.

model_provider.value: Luminance's proprietary Luna Crescent LLM; OpenAI
model_provider.notes: The technology page identifies Luna Crescent as Luminance's proprietary LLM (https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology), while its Trust Center lists OpenAI as a generative model provider (https://trust.luminance.com/). No particular OpenAI model version is established.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR.
